exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Delivery location (hospital vs. commune health center)
cohort: 57,561 people from 17,993 households in Chi Linh, Vietnam, followed since 2004
finding: While there was a significant increase in hospital deliveries and cesarean section rates, birth weights remained stable over the decade.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates increased significantly over the study period.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
